summary: This clinical trial studies a drug called tirzepatide combined with acetazolamide to treat a condition called idiopathic intracranial hypertension, which involves increased pressure around the brain. The study plans to enroll 75 participants to see if adding tirzepatide can help lower the needed dose of standard medication. Brigham and Women's Hospital is sponsoring this Phase 2 clinical trial, which is currently not yet recruiting.
